name: Baeza (Spain)
description: Square purple flag charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Baeza (a castle and a cross on red) between the words BAEZA, HUMANIDAD, CIUDAD and PATRIMONIO.
history: The flag of Baeza displays the municipal heraldry on a purple cloth, in conformity with the purple banner of León.
